# Request file for .github/workflows/fetch-refs.yml.
#
# Change this file and push it on a FEATURE BRANCH (the workflow ignores
# main), and it runs with these values on a GitHub runner, which can reach
# Wikimedia Commons. browse and resolve only print to the run's log. fetch
# downloads into references/jewish/, appends SOURCES.md, rewrites this
# file to `mode: done`, and commits all of it back to the branch — so a
# fulfilled request stays fulfilled when the branch merges.
#
# To make a new request: bump `request`, set mode/items/force, push.
#
# mode:  browse | resolve | fetch | done
# items: semicolon-separated — categories (browse), File: titles (resolve),
#        or slot=File:Title pairs (fetch; slots in tools/fetch_jewish_refs.py)
# force: true to let fetch replace a file that already exists

request: 3
mode: done  # fulfilled 2026-09-21 by run 35648219966; re-ran on main by mistake before this guard existed
items: torah_yad=File:Jüdisches Museum München 3.jpg
force: true
